name: Seihendain -Mesuka Danshi no Owarinaki Yuetsu-
original_name: 性変堕淫 -雌化男子の終わりなき愉悦-
source:
One day, some lingerie arrived on the doorstep with a threatening note.

"I know everything. Your corporate embezzling will be reported unless you wear this."

So began my coerced journey... from myself, to drag queen, to full woman.

It was a nightmare at first, but in then end an enlightening metamorphosis. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE172668.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
有一天，一件内衣送到了家门口，上面还附有一张威胁字条。

“我什么都知道。你不穿这个，你的公司贪污行为就会被举报。”

于是我的被迫旅程开始了……从我自己，到变装皇后，到真正的女人。

起初这是一场噩梦，但最终却是一个启发性的转变。
